title: Icon spacing setting not available for pinned app icons of Icons-and-Text task manager
line: The Icons-and-Text Task Manager now has the "Spacing between icons" setting, and it spaces pinned app icons like the Icons-only Task Manager does.
explanation: In the Icons-and-Text Task Manager, pinned launchers had a hard-coded maximum width equal to the panel's height, so they sat tightly together, and the "Spacing between icons" combo box was only shown for the Icons-only variant. The Icons-only Task Manager instead adds the task frame's side margins multiplied by the spacing setting. The change adds the same spacing to the launchers' maximum width in Icons-and-Text and shows the combo box there on horizontal panels; window tasks with labels are unchanged.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: apply icon spacing to Icons-and-Text launchers

Pinned launchers in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager were always as wide
as the panel is tall, so they looked crowded next to the Icons-only one
and the spacing setting was hidden. Apply the setting to them, show it.

BUG: 502298

patches.diff:
From 20bb71daeadad1025da71078cb221ec1d5c23754 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 18:14:35 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/taskmanager: apply icon spacing to Icons-and-Text
 launchers

Pinned launchers in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager were always as wide
as the panel is tall, so they looked crowded next to the Icons-only one
and the spacing setting was hidden. Apply the setting to them, show it.

BUG: 502298
---
 applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml | 2 +-
 applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml             | 2 +-
 2 files changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
index 6f19a68e96..72bdc88a29 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/ConfigAppearance.qml
@@ -155,7 +155,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
         }
 
         QQC2.ComboBox {
-            visible: root.iconOnly
+            visible: root.iconOnly || !root.plasmoidVertical
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:listbox", "Spacing between icons:")
 
             model: [
diff --git a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
index 90530078c5..75959a1fab 100644
--- a/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
+++ b/applets/taskmanager/qml/Task.qml
@@ -44,7 +44,7 @@ PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea {
     Layout.fillHeight: !inPopup
     Layout.maximumWidth: tasksRoot.vertical
         ? -1
-        : ((model.IsLauncher && !tasksRoot.iconsOnly) ? tasksRoot.height / taskList.rows : TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMaxWidth())
+        : ((model.IsLauncher && !tasksRoot.iconsOnly) ? tasksRoot.height / taskList.rows + (taskFrame.margins.left + taskFrame.margins.right) * Plasmoid.configuration.iconSpacing : TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMaxWidth())
     Layout.maximumHeight: tasksRoot.vertical ? TaskManagerApplet.LayoutMetrics.preferredMaxHeight() : -1
 
     required property var model
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Panel with Icons-only (left) and Icons-and-Text (right) task managers, both with the same three pinned apps and Normal spacing: the Icons-and-Text launchers are crowded (about 36 px apart vs 45 px).
Same panel with the fix: the Icons-and-Text launchers use Normal spacing and match the Icons-only ones.
Icons-and-Text Task Manager settings on master: no spacing option.
With the fix the "Spacing between icons" option is shown (horizontal panels).
